# Taste MCP

> Design taste for coding agents, condensed from 14 open-source design repos. Add the MCP (https://agent-taste.vercel.app/mcp) or read the guides below before building UI.

- [Typography](https://justkamal07.github.io/taste-mcp/guides/typography.md)

- [GSAP, Scroll Worlds and WebGL over HTML](https://justkamal07.github.io/taste-mcp/guides/gsap-scroll.md)
